channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Foreign visitors to Japan hit record 3.9 million in October
item.description: More foreign tourists, mainly from other areas in Asia and Europe, are believed to have visited Japan to enjoy the country's autumn season.

item.title: Japan improves on English learning in global ranking, but still lags behind
item.description: Its 86th place in the 2026 EF English Proficiency Index, though higher than last year, puts it behind peers in Asia and elsewhere in the world.

item.title: Rising star Atamifuji has been the story of the Kyushu Basho
item.description: The sekiwake is off to his best start in years and is in prime position to claim his first Emperor's Cup, and possibly even earn a promotion.

item.title: Historic wins but no trophies: Moriyasu’s mixed legacy as Japan coach
item.description: The biggest achievement of Japan's longest-serving coach is said to be building a team "that runs itself."

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
